transcript.text: Good morning everyone. Let's get started on tomorrow's receiving plan. We've got two inbound lots — generator housings and communications cable reels — and three staging lanes available. Before I publish final lane assignments, I need to hear from each of you on anything that might affect how we assign those lanes. Warehouse ops, movement control — any changes or constraints I should know about?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag a constraint on the lane assignments. This morning I confirmed that only Lane 2 has a current floor-load certification for the 1,800-kilogram generator-housing pallet. The certification is filed in the warehouse binder, but it hasn't been added to the yard diagram yet — so the draft plan showing all three lanes as interchangeable doesn't reflect this. The generator-housing pallet needs to go to Lane 2.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to flag a constraint on Lane 3. This afternoon I received the carrier's vehicle diagram and confirmed that the cable-reel tilt-bed requires a 4.0-meter turning clearance that's only available at Lane 3. That diagram hasn't been included in the movement-control brief yet, so the draft plan doesn't reflect this. The cable reels need to go to Lane 3.
transcript.speaker: A3
